description: Load test spec contract — validates tool, scenarios, thresholds, safety constraints, and output configuration

rules.description: spec.tool must be one of: k6, artillery, locust, gatling, jmeter, autocannon, wrk, vegeta
At least one scenario must be of type 'smoke' with vus ≤ 5 and duration ≤ 2m
All non-smoke scenarios must declare explicit thresholds
At least one scenario must declare errorRate threshold (0.0–1.0)
Stress/spike/soak/breakpoint scenarios must not target production environments
outputArtifacts must declare at least one output destination
